text:
ashley: Heads up — canary promotion for release/2026.03.22 is blocked. deploy-bot paused the promotion because staging-smoke failed (12/15).

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release/2026.03.22. Failed checks: staging-smoke (12/15). CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821

ashley: quick paste of the failing lines from the staging job logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:07:23Z ERROR migration_runner: timeout waiting for advisory lock on migrations
2026-03-22T14:07:23Z INFO retrying migration 20260321_add_indexes.sql (attempt 3/3)
2026-03-22T14:07:30Z ERROR migration_runner: migration failed: could not acquire lock after 30s
```

sam: That looks like the advisory-lock race we've hit when parallel schema jobs run. Usually a DB reset + rerun fixes it but it's flaky.

maria: We have a 2 hour change window. If we rerun and it flakes again we'll miss the cutover.

jon: Options: 1) reset staging DB and rerun (fast if lucky), 2) pin to last-good image and promote now, 3) block release until we root cause.

sam: Pinning seems safest for the release window. We can push a follow-up rollback/fix later.

ashley: I'm leaning pin -> promote. Suggested image: gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 (passed full smoke yesterday).

maria: +1. Need to document the pin in release notes and ops runbook (how to revert).

ashley: @deploy-bot please queue manual promote for that image. Command (manual):
```
/deploy promote --image gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 --env prod --by ashley
```

deploy-bot: Manual promotion scheduled: release/2026.03.22 -> image gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-21-ab12cd3 by ashley. ETA: 2026-03-22T16:00:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 4821`

ci-runner: I'm starting a diagnostic rerun on staging job 4821 (4821-rerun). I'll capture pg_locks and `SELECT * FROM pg_advisory_lock_status();` during the run.

jon: Please also add a short release-note line: "Promoted previous stable image to avoid intermittent DB migration lock in staging; hotfix PR pending."

ashley: I'll add that now to the release notes and create a follow-up issue to fix migration locking and add test harness.

maria: bump: make sure the hotfix PR includes a deterministic migration lock (advisory lock ordering) or serialization guard.

ashley: agreed. Pin approved, promote queued. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Promotion completed successfully at 2026-03-22T16:01:12Z. Release pinned and promoted to prod.

ashley: marking this thread resolved. Follow-up: #1234 (migration-lock-hotfix) created and assigned to @sam.

sam: got it — I'll own the fix and keep you posted.

ci-runner: diagnostic logs attached to the rerun build: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/4821/4821-rerun/logs (captured locks + stacktrace).
